note: REDUCED-COVERAGE smoke tier for `npm run test:fast`. One section per feature area, picked for breadth per second rather than depth: it is meant to catch a change that broke something obvious in seconds, NOT to clear a commit — the full suite is the gate, and CI runs it. Adding an area to the editor means adding its section here. Names must match a head() string in e2e.mjs EXACTLY: a name that matches nothing silently shrinks the tier instead of erroring, which is why budget.mjs reports renamed sections.
budgetNote: Held under ~10s wall at 6 workers. Serial cost of this list is 37.6s; at ~3.8x parallel speedup that is ~9.9s.
